facts.fact: Neela told the Company her intended answer at the cairn fire the night before (as promised in ch 22); the answer to the queen was moved from the dusk to the afternoon of ch 24 after Koman's report.
facts.why: needed because ch 23 ended with the assault arriving at dusk, so the answer had to come earlier.

facts.fact: The queen keeps the unread oilcloth writ question open: Devan does not read it, and the queen says she knows what it says and would rather it were read after the ladders come down.
facts.why: needed because Devan promised to read it after Neela answered; the beat has him silent.

facts.fact: Sanu chooses Kandan to self-name to; Sajan stays among the four unready guards with Lata and two others. Thulasi names to Madhavi. A crown spear-captain with a grey moustache is chosen by a guard.
facts.why: needed to name pairs and the four unready guards.

facts.fact: Bhaskaran's wife and Kuttu's choice of him were arranged at the cairn fire an hour before dusk; Bhaskaran applies the resin to Kuttu's throat because Kuttu is shaking.
facts.why: needed to ground Kuttu's naming to Bhaskaran.

facts.fact: Queen Nirmala now feels the share with Usha and admits 'it does sting'.
facts.why: needed to show the cost of Usha naming to the queen.
